subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu upgrades require explicit `allowBots: true` for bot-authored events, or preserve current ungated admission when the platform delivers those events?
rationale: The latest head deliberately chooses safer default-off admission, but that changes current runtime behavior for existing multi-bot deployments and cannot be decided from tests alone.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Retain default-off admission, document the upgrade impact, and align the stale PR body with the boolean setting and shared loop guard.

options.title: Preserve current admission
options.body: Treat an unset value as admitted and provide explicit `false` only for operators who want bot messages disabled.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Retain default-off admission, document the upgrade impact, and align the stale PR body with the boolean setting and shared loop guard.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and authored the latest consolidated head containing the policy change.
